title: Paris Saint‑Germain faces Brest in a match marked by goal and injury
seoTitle: PSG vs Brest: Goal, Injury, Tribute
subtitle: The match at Francis‑Le‑Blé stadium featured an emotional tribute and medical concerns for the French capital’s team
excerpt: Paris Saint‑Germain played against Stade Brestois in the national championship. The game featured Ferran Torres’ goal, Achraf Hakimi’s injury and a tribute to Éric Roy.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Paris Saint‑Germain took the field against Stade Brestois in a match marked by emotional tributes and medical concerns for the French capital’s team. The encounter, held at the Francis‑Le‑Blé stadium, highlighted Ferran Torres’ goal and the injury of defender Achraf Hakimi. These events stir the club’s backstage just a week before the classic against Olympique de Marseille.

Emotional tribute to coach Éric Roy

Before the start of the match, Stade Brestois paid tribute to its former coach Éric Roy, who passed away on June 17 at the age of 58 after battling pancreatic cancer. Roy’s daughter spoke into the microphone at the Francis‑Le‑Blé stadium, describing football as a matter of love, passion, and unity. Brest players wore red shirts without their own names, replaced by the nickname “King Eric” and a crown printed on the chest. On the Paris Saint‑Germain side, Marquinhos, Luis Enrique, and Luis Campos placed a wreath of flowers in front of the official stand, and both teams wore black armbands in a sign of mourning. Roy had taken over Brest in 2023 and guided the club to the Champions League in his first full season.

The course of the match and Ferran Torres’ goal

On the pitch, Paris Saint‑Germain managed to open the score at 61 minutes. The goal was scored by Ferran Torres, cementing a highly productive moment for the player, who netted his fourth goal in a span of just four days, shortly after scoring three goals against Bratislava. The match put Brest’s defensive organization against the visitors’ need for offensive dominance.

Concern over Achraf Hakimi’s injury

Despite the lead on the scoreboard, Paris Saint‑Germain suffered a significant setback during the encounter. The Moroccan player Achraf Hakimi appeared to suffer an adductor injury. The player’s physical condition poses a serious problem for the Parisian coaching staff, occurring exactly one week before the important classic against Olympique de Marseille.

The current standing of both teams in the league

The start of the season for Paris Saint‑Germain has been tougher than usual, with the team sitting in 14th place on the table with just two points before the round began, having two draws and one loss in their previous three games. In contrast, Stade Brestois began the round in 7th place with five points, recording one win and two draws in their last three matches. Despite the recent favorable record for Brest, the head‑to‑head history showed a wide superiority for PSG, who won the last five matches played between the two teams.
